engineContract.entryModel: FIRST_EXPLICIT_SESSION_CLOSE_STRICTLY_AFTER_AVAILABILITY (session close times from quant/engines/realtime/trading-session.js + quant/config/market-calendar.json, XNYS, incl. early closes)
engineContract.benchmark: SPY daily split-adjusted price series quant/data/market/discover-series/ref_SPY.json (sha256 f04a3ea0bc79a51bd811073d8f25ab4642affffa18aa0ed40b5552efc6dc950e), passive, no costs
engineContract.registrationTimestampMeaning: Wall-clock freeze of rule before any event outcome was computed. Retrospective window is historical data; this is NOT an untouched preregistration in the confirmatory sense (see priorExposure).

eventDefinition.category: Original Form 8-K (form field exactly '8-K') whose SEC submissions JSON 'items' field contains '2.02' (Results of Operations and Financial Condition).
eventDefinition.notEarningsClaim: Item 2.02 is a disclosure category; it is not verified to be a quarterly earnings release in every case.
eventDefinition.source: https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json (recent block; older 'files' pages only when recent does not reach 2025-08-15). Accession number and acceptanceDateTime per filing.
eventDefinition.availabilityClock: SEC acceptance time. Interpretation of submissions acceptanceDateTime (true UTC vs Eastern digits labelled Z) is fixed by the stratified header-parity sample (>=200 original filings, seed V9-EVENTS-HEADER-PARITY-1) against SGML <ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME> (US Eastern). If the sample is INCONSISTENT the study is not run.
eventDefinition.availabilityMeaning: Acceptance is an UPPER BOUND on public availability. The company press release (e.g. newswire) may precede it; then next-close entry is look-ahead-free but possibly late. publishedAt is set equal to acceptance for engine purposes only; company publication time is NOT established.
eventDefinition.window: acceptanceUtc > 2025-09-30T20:00:00.000Z (first daily close in the series) and <= 2026-10-26T23:59:59.999Z. Earlier acceptances = PRE_WINDOW (counted; used only for control exclusion). Later acceptances before the prospective freeze = GAP_NOT_EVALUATED (counted).
eventDefinition.amendments: 8-K/A (with or without Item 2.02) are counted, never treated as original events. An 8-K/A Item 2.02 still blocks control eligibility.
eventDefinition.sameEntryDuplicates: Per issuer (CIK), several original Item 2.02 8-Ks mapping to the same calendar entry session: keep earliest acceptance (tie: accession); others counted SAME_ENTRY_DUPLICATE.

population.candidateSource: quant/data/market/discover-series/ref_*.json (daily, SPLIT_ADJUSTED, real, USD, 2025-09-30..2026-10-26) built by scripts/quant/v9/events/population.cjs (population.json sha256 b67744ba7fc3c758767aaf98b196e4dab84055c322421a3486df726d1fc8bbcd: 6679 files, 4431 eligible).
listingGuardsInOrder: 1 security master (sha256 26c82617913ab0dcbd08d24c80eb818134ccced74cc01e9eac819b4635498332): unique baseline_security_id row, instrument_type EQUITY_COMMON, eligible_us_equity, primary_listing, exchange NYSE->XNYS, NASDAQ->XNAS, AMEX/NYSE MKT->XASE (others excluded); master ticker equals series ticker
3 ticker present in SEC company_tickers_exchange.json (current mapping) with exactly one CIK
4 SEC exchange compatible with master: NASDAQ<->'Nasdaq'; NYSE/AMEX/NYSE MKT<->'NYSE'; else EXCHANGE_MISMATCH
6 no formerNames entry with 'to' >= 2025-08-15 (NAME_CHANGE_IN_WINDOW; ticker reuse / identity change guard)
8 daily series must not start before master listing start date (DAILY_PRECEDES_LISTING_START)
9 every daily date is an XNYS trading day in the study calendar
10 one listing per CIK: the ticker that appears first in submissions 'tickers'; others SECONDARY_LISTING_SAME_CIK
11 issuer has >=1 original Item 2.02 8-K accepted in [2025-08-15, 2026-10-26]; else NO_ITEM202_REPORTER (excluded from events and controls)
population.survivorship: Current listings and current SEC ticker map only. Delisted/acquired issuers in the window are absent. Results are conditional on survival to 2026-10-26 and current classification.

controls.design: Pre-registered placebo control listings (eventType CONTROL) run through the same engine with the event's acceptance time as availableAt, hence identical entry session and horizons.
controls.candidates: Retained listings of other issuers with a daily bar on the event's calendar entry session and on the preceding session, and with NO Item 2.02 filing (8-K or 8-K/A, any harvested date incl. after asOf) whose calendar entry session lies within [-10, +21] sessions of the event's entry session (extended XNYS session list from the market calendar).
controls.selection: Rank candidates by sha256(seed + '|' + eventId + '|' + listingId) ascending; take first k.

outcomes.abnormalReturn: AR = engine grossReturn - engine benchmarkReturn (SPY close-to-close over identical entry/exit dates).
outcomes.netExcess: engine benchmarkExcess = netReturn (10+5 bps per side) - benchmarkReturn.
outcomes.entrySessionRule: If the engine entry date differs from the first calendar session whose close is strictly after acceptance (listing gap), the row is ENTRY_SESSION_GAP and excluded from endpoints (counted).
outcomes.maturity: Engine IMMATURE/CENSORED/INELIGIBLE states counted per horizon; IMMATURE rows are reported with expected maturity, never dropped silently.

primaryEndpoints.A_h: Mean over events (OBSERVED, no entry gap, >=1 OBSERVED control) of D = |AR_event| - mean_controls |AR_control|. Positive-control hypothesis: D > 0 (earnings-type disclosures raise return variance). Two-sided test of mean D = 0.
primaryEndpoints.B_h: Mean engine benchmarkExcess of the same events. Expected ~0. Two-sided test of mean = 0. No trading-strategy claim in either direction.

inference.primary: Two-way cluster SE via research-studies.cjs#inference (time cluster = event entry session date, issuer cluster = CIK); two-sided normal p-value; Holm (research-validation.cjs#holm) across the 6 endpoints, alpha 0.05.
inference.robustness: research-validation.cjs#inferTemporalBlockMean: circular calendar-block bootstrap over the study session calendar, observation date = entry session, blockLength 20, minimumBlockLength 20, replicates 9999, seed 20261027, alpha 0.05, assumption CONDITIONAL_WEAK_STATIONARITY_AND_MIXING.
inference.methodValidityCriterion: Positive control DETECTED iff A1 mean > 0, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND block-bootstrap 95% CI for A1 excludes 0. Otherwise NOT_DETECTED (reported as such).
inference.multiplicityNote: 1.1.0 is a post-hoc sensitivity; its p-values are not confirmatory and are not pooled with 1.0.0.

diagnostics.preEntryMove: For each event: last session close at or before acceptance -> entry close (gross, and minus SPY over same dates); summarised by acceptance bucket in US Eastern: PRE_OPEN (<09:30), REGULAR (09:30-close), POST_CLOSE (>=close same day), NON_SESSION_DAY.
diagnostics.clustering: events per entry date (top dates, share in largest 20 dates), events per issuer, same-issuer overlapping 20-bar windows, month distribution.

independentReference: scripts/quant/v9/events/reference_check.py (stdlib) re-derives listing guards, events, controls, session closes (zoneinfo), entry/exit, returns, AR, cluster SEs and bootstrap from raw inputs; parity declared at abs tolerance 1e-12 for returns and 1e-9 relative for SEs/p-values.
priorExposure: No 8-K Item 2.02 outcome in this window was computed before this freeze. Before freezing, ~36 raw acceptanceDateTime strings were viewed (no prices). The daily window 2025-09-30..2026-10-26 was used in V8 for 11 named survivors and V8 used 12 SEC acceptance headers (JPM, MSFT, NVDA, XOM); the price window is therefore explored history, and this study is retrospective/exploratory evidence, not an independent holdout.

relationTo_1_0_0.status: POST_HOC_SENSITIVITY_AFTER_SEEING_1_0_0_RESULTS; 1.0.0 remains the registered primary analysis and is reported unchanged.
relationTo_1_0_0.reason: Design defect found in 1.0.0: control exclusion of +-10 sessions is shorter than the 20-bar horizon, so a control may contain its own Item 2.02 announcement inside bars 11-20 after entry, while the event window starts after its own announcement reaction. This biases A20 (and in principle A5 is unaffected since 5 <= 10) against events. 1.0.0 showed A20 mean D < 0 (events |AR| 0.1002 vs controls 0.1176).
relationTo_1_0_0.onlyChange: controls.exclusionSessions = {before: 10, after: 21}: no Item 2.02 filing (8-K or 8-K/A) whose calendar entry session j satisfies si-10 <= j <= si+21 (covers the full 20-bar outcome window plus one session). Everything else identical.
